data_fields.name: build_period
data_fields.donor_constant: one build per new day (flag reset by day loop)

data_fields.name: service_prerequisites
data_fields.donor_constant: mask per race and building, all bits required

data_fields.name: service_cost
data_fields.donor_constant: PaymentConditions::BuyBuilding per race and building (not read)

data_fields.name: magic_guild_chain_step
data_fields.donor_constant: one-bit shift to the previous level

best_idea: A hub's services unlock one at a time through a fixed ladder (built, disabled, once per period, core first, all prerequisites built, affordable); buying re-checks the ladder, pays, records and closes the period.
decision_why: The ladder and one-build-per-period gate fit zone hub build-out with prerequisites as zone data; the donor's bit-shift chain and race branches are not copied.
acceptance: Server test: a fresh hub can buy only the core; a prerequisite-gated service is refused until its prerequisite is built; a second buy in the same period is refused as not today; the next period allows exactly one buy.
